study type: Secondary analysis of a multicentre randomised controlled trial
exposure: prophylactic closed-incision negative pressure wound therapy dressing (from original RCT)
cohort: The study included 1459 women with a pre-pregnancy body mass index (BMI) >=30 kg/m2 who gave birth by elective caesarean section.
finding: The cumulative incidence of surgical site infection (SSI) was 8.4%, with BMI >=40 kg/m2, >=2 previous pregnancies, and lack of pre-caesarean section vaginal cleansing identified as independent risk factors for SSI.
mod_finding: The study identified specific predictors of surgical site infection in women who underwent elective caesarean section.
